decisions.reason: As a close-to-core pipeline product for existing utility and contractor customers, it is more likely to meet aspiration levels and justify continued commitment than the firm's more experimental launches.

As a distant single-product diversification, it likely falls short of aspiration levels relative to the stronger core business and is a natural candidate for reallocating resources back to established infrastructure products.
Although the product line offers some municipal cross-selling potential, it remains distant from the firm's technical core and would likely be cut if its results stay uncertain or below aspirations.

This niche public-space line uses existing metalworking capabilities but sits outside the main water and wastewater offer, so boundedly rational management would likely drop it if it does not clearly outperform the firm's aspiration benchmark.
